description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractAdapter' that provides common functionality for adapting messages between internal representations and external protocols within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for converting adaptables, extracting headers, and mapping signal objects, serving as a base for concrete adapter implementations.

classes.name: AbstractAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for protocol adapters, including message translation, header processing, and type determination.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an external adaptable message into an internal JSONifiable representation, handling headers and type identification.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an internal JSONifiable signal into an external adaptable message, adding appropriate headers.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Generates a string representing the message type based on the topic path and payload.

methods.name: getTypeCriterionAsString
methods.description: Extracts the criterion component from a topic path for message typing purposes.
